GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out sat last 6l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # poor

Debut for stable. Away well. Not pushed early & raced keenly 4th Two Wide (4L from lead). Stayed same until pushed out 3 Wide @ 400m. Pushed along Five Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 250m & Held Ground in last 200m. blinkers off again. # One-paced.
Jumped Well joint lead rail, pushed along turn, Straightened Up half clear, drew 1 length clear passing 200m, 2 Lengths clear 100m and kept going strong to the line # Eq led/too good
Jumped Fair sat 3 Lengths off but 3 Wide No Cover , pushed 4-5 Wide turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, found little and gave ground # 3-4 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled very wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 1.5 Lengths 3 Wide , Moved Up and joined Lead at 600m, led by a head turning, Headed again after Straightening Up and Dropped Out in straight. [Stewards questioned rider re performance. Jockey stated it settled 3-wide outside the leaders, sprinted fairly on straightening, peaked at the 200m and weakened to the line. She opined it had not been able to run out the 1200m distance (first attempt) given its tough run early/middle stages. Post-race vet exam did not reveal any significant abnormality.] # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping.  When questioned regarding the performance of the mare apprentice stated that her mount settled three wide outside the leaders in the early and middle stages. App stated that her mount sprinted fairly on straightening however felt to peak on its run near the 200m and weakened in its run to the line. App stated that her mount was attempting the 1200m journey for the first time and in her opinion it was unable to run out the distance today are a tough run in the early and middle stages. P/R vet no ab's.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well Wide early eased back 2-3l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up widest 2-3l off, found little and faded # Wide trip/no fight
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported that after his mount began well, he initially anticipated obtaining a position in the lead. He said that after passing the 800m, and when other runners to his inside showed superior speed, he elected to obtain a position with cover behind rnr. He said that thereafter, the mare was disappointing in the matter in which it failed to finish its race off. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities. Rdr was spoken to regarding the use of his whip above shoulder height.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat handy 1 length of but 3 wide, improved turn, Straightened Up half off, joint lead 200m, narrowly headed passing 100m, kept on strong just no match winner late # 3 wide/kept finding
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled wide and without cover for the majority of the event. Was inclined to lay inwards during the early part of the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok bustled settled 2-3l off, eased 3 Wide turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, running on 1 length off 150m, peaked on run at 100m, kept on fairly late # run ended 100m
Bit Slow Out recovered to settle 3l off, held up turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off all clear, ran on well making good ground, just no match leader/winner, maybe minor excuse # found 1 better
